title: Rapier +2
summary: Finesse rapier with Flourish, Piercing Strike and Weakening Strike.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d8 + 2 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. Martial, one-handed, Finesse and Dippable, 5 ft melee. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Flourish: Bonus Action, 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. Dexterity save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns. Off Balance gives Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks and gives attackers Advantage until damage or Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Piercing Strike: Action, melee weapon damage. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. In standard modes hits on the target gain 2 extra Piercing damage. In Honour Mode it takes 2 extra damage of the original type from damage sources. Healing clears the condition. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Weakening Strike: Action for 1d4 + attack ability modifier nonlethal weapon-type damage. Armed target makes a Strength save against weapon-action DC +2 or has Weak Grip for 2 turns. It gives Disadvantage on attacks and Strength saves. Help clears it. Once per Short Rest with proficiency.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
